summary: Sadot Group filed an 8-K announcing the October 12, 2026 termination of its September 30, 2026 Joint Venture and Operating Agreement with VisionWave Holdings, VisionWave IL, CMJV LLC, C.M. Composite Materials Ltd. and Matania Moskovich, unwinding the 50/50 joint venture around Israeli composites maker CM. Sadot had committed $7,814,323 in staged cash contributions and issued 250,000 Entry Premium Shares, which VisionWave retains. CM could not produce required IFRS/US GAAP audited financials or engage a PCAOB auditor, blocking draws and SEC reporting. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for residual investment or disclosure risk.
